question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She swallowed _________ her breakfast in a hurry.
solution:
The correct answer is '**down**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** word to fill in the blank is '**down**'.
 
• The **idiom **'**Swallowed down**' means '**To eat or drink something, especially very quickly**'.
 
• Hence, the correct option is '**down**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at some similar idioms.
 
 
• 
 
**Made a pig of themselves**- *When someone eats way too much, then this expression is used informally.*

 **E.g.** *I made a real pig of myself at the party.*__

 
 
• 
 
**Eat like a horse**- *Someone who eats a lot regularly.*

 **E.g.** __*Rohit is thin as a stick yet he eats like a horse.*__

 
 
• 
 
**Wolf food down**- *Eating a lot very quickly.*

 **E.g.** __*The kids wolfed the burgers down and then started on the pizza.*__
